name: setup-observability
description: Deploy the redpanda-data/observability stack (Prometheus + Grafana) and publish a public Grafana endpoint; skips if already running
author: Claude Code Autonomous Agent

network: TCP 3000 open to internet on monitoring host
TCP 9644 from monitoring host to brokers
internet access for get.docker.com, Docker Hub, GitHub

inputs.monitoring-host: public IP of the dedicated monitoring node

outputs.grafana_endpoint: https://<ip-with-dashes>.sslip.io (Let's Encrypt TLS via Caddy, anonymous read-only)
